noah_ark.question: Who built an ark to save his family from the flood?
noah_ark.about: The world had become full of violence, but Noah walked with God. God told him to build a huge boat, an ark, to save his family and the animals from the coming flood.
noah_ark.think: Noah obeyed before a single drop of rain fell. What is God asking you to trust Him with today?

born_where.question: In which town was Jesus born?
born_where.about: Joseph and Mary had to travel to Bethlehem, the town of King David, for a census. There Jesus was born, just as the prophet Micah had foretold.
born_where.think: The King of kings was laid in a manger. God comes close to the humble places of your life.

seventh_day.question: What did God do on the seventh day?
seventh_day.about: In six days God made the heavens, the earth and everything in them. On the seventh day He rested and blessed that day, making it holy.
seventh_day.think: Even God rested. Is there time this week to stop, rest and remember that He holds the world?

water_wine.question: What did Jesus turn water into at the wedding in Cana?
water_wine.about: At a wedding in Cana the wine ran out, which was a great shame for the family. This was the first of Jesus' miraculous signs, and His disciples believed in Him.
water_wine.think: The servants did whatever Jesus told them and saw a miracle. Is there a small step He is asking of you?

flood_days.question: For how many days and nights did it rain in the flood?
flood_days.about: God sent the flood because of the world's wickedness, but He kept Noah and his family safe in the ark. The rain fell for forty days and forty nights.
flood_days.think: Forty days felt endless, yet God remembered Noah. He has not forgotten you in your long season either.

baptism.question: At Jesus' baptism, what came down on Him like a dove?
baptism.about: Jesus came to the Jordan River to be baptised by John. As He came up out of the water, heaven opened and the Father spoke His love over Him.
baptism.think: The Father said, "This is my beloved Son." In Christ, God calls you His beloved too.

abraham_stars.question: God told Abraham to count what, to show how many his descendants would be?
abraham_stars.about: Abraham was old and had no children, yet God promised him a family. God took him outside and showed him the night sky.
abraham_stars.think: Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness. Which promise of God will you hold on to today?

fishers.question: What were Peter and Andrew doing when Jesus called them to follow Him?
fishers.about: Peter and his brother Andrew were fishermen on the Sea of Galilee. Jesus called them to follow Him and become fishers of people.
fishers.think: They left their nets at once. What might Jesus be calling you to leave behind to follow Him?

ram.question: When Abraham was about to offer Isaac, what did God provide instead?
ram.about: God tested Abraham by asking him to offer his only son, Isaac. At the last moment God stopped him and provided a ram caught in a bush.
ram.think: Abraham called the place "The LORD will provide." God sees what you need before you do.

salt_light.question: Jesus said His followers are the salt of the earth and the … of the world?
salt_light.about: In the Sermon on the Mount Jesus taught His followers how to live. Salt gives flavour and preserves; light shows the way to others.
salt_light.think: No one hides a lamp under a basket. Where can your light shine for someone this week?

jacob_ladder.question: What did Jacob see in his dream at Bethel?
jacob_ladder.about: Jacob was running away from his brother Esau, alone and afraid. That night God met him in a dream and promised to be with him.
jacob_ladder.think: God told Jacob, "I am with you and will keep you wherever you go." You are not alone on your journey.

daily_bread.question: In the Lord's Prayer, what do we ask God to give us today?
daily_bread.about: The disciples asked Jesus to teach them to pray, and He gave them this prayer. Asking for daily bread means trusting God for each day's needs.
daily_bread.think: Jesus taught us to ask for today's needs, one day at a time. What do you need from God today?

joseph_coat.question: What special gift did Jacob give his son Joseph?
joseph_coat.about: Jacob loved Joseph more than his other sons and showed it with a special robe. His brothers grew jealous and hated him.
joseph_coat.think: The gift stirred up his brothers' jealousy. Ask God to help you celebrate others instead of envying them.

birds.question: Jesus said not to worry, because our heavenly Father feeds what?
birds.about: Many people worry about food, clothes and the future. Jesus pointed to the birds and flowers to show how faithfully the Father cares for His creation.
birds.think: If He feeds the birds, how much more will He care for you? Hand Him today's worry.

joseph_sold.question: Who was sold by his brothers and later saved his family from famine in Egypt?
joseph_sold.about: Joseph's jealous brothers sold him as a slave into Egypt. Years later, as a ruler there, he forgave them and saved them from famine.
joseph_sold.think: Joseph said, "It was not you who sent me here, but God." God can turn harm into good.

ask_seek.question: "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; …" How does Jesus end it?
options: Knock, and it will be opened to you
Give, and you will be given
ask_seek.about: Jesus taught that God is a good Father who loves to give good gifts to His children. So we can keep praying and never give up.
ask_seek.think: Jesus invites you to keep asking. What have you stopped praying about that you could bring to Him again?

baby_moses.question: Where did Moses' mother hide her baby to save him?
options: In a basket among the reeds by the river
baby_moses.about: Pharaoh had ordered every Hebrew baby boy to be killed. Moses' mother hid him in a basket on the Nile, where Pharaoh's daughter found him.
baby_moses.think: A mother's small act of faith became part of God's great plan. Your small faithfulness matters too.

storm.question: What did Jesus calm with a word while His disciples were in the boat?
storm.about: Jesus was asleep in the boat when a fierce storm broke over the lake. The frightened disciples woke Him, and He calmed the wind and the waves with a word.
storm.think: The disciples cried, "Don't you care?" He did, and He spoke peace. Bring Him the storm you are in.

burning_bush.question: How did God first speak to Moses in the desert?
burning_bush.about: Moses was looking after sheep in the desert when he saw a bush on fire that did not burn up. God spoke to him from it and sent him to free Israel.
burning_bush.think: Moses was doing his everyday work when God called. Look for God in the ordinary places of your day.

jairus.question: How old was Jairus' daughter when Jesus raised her to life?
jairus.about: Jairus, a leader of the synagogue, begged Jesus to come to his dying daughter. Before Jesus arrived, word came that she had died.
jairus.think: Jesus told Jairus, "Don't be afraid; just believe." Hold on to Him when the news is bad.

red_sea.question: How did Israel escape when Pharaoh's army chased them to the sea?
red_sea.about: Israel had just left slavery in Egypt when Pharaoh's army chased them to the Red Sea. God parted the waters so His people could walk through.
red_sea.think: When there seemed to be no way, God made one. Ask Him for a way through what blocks you.

loaves.question: How many loaves did the boy have when Jesus fed the five thousand?
loaves.about: A huge crowd had followed Jesus to a remote place, and there was nothing to eat. A boy offered his small lunch, and Jesus fed everyone with it.
loaves.think: A boy's small lunch became a feast in Jesus' hands. Give Him what little you have.

manna.question: What did God send each morning to feed Israel in the wilderness?
manna.about: In the wilderness Israel complained of hunger. God sent manna each morning, enough for each day, for forty years.
manna.think: Manna came fresh each day and could not be stored up. God gives grace for today; trust Him for tomorrow.

walks_water.question: Who walked on the water toward Jesus, then began to sink?
walks_water.about: After feeding the crowd, Jesus sent His disciples across the lake and came to them in the night, walking on the water. Peter asked to come to Him.
walks_water.think: Peter sank when he looked at the wind, and Jesus caught him at once. Keep your eyes on Him.

sinai.question: On which mountain did God give Moses the tablets of the law?
sinai.about: After leading Israel out of Egypt, Moses met God on Mount Sinai. There God gave him the law, written on two tablets of stone.
sinai.think: God's law was written by His own finger. Which of His words do you need written on your heart today?

samaritan.question: In Jesus' story, who stopped to help the man beaten by robbers?
samaritan.about: An expert in the law asked Jesus, "Who is my neighbour?" Jesus answered with a story in which the hero was a Samaritan, a man most Jews of the day looked down on.
samaritan.think: Jesus asked, "Which of these was a neighbour?" Who is lying by your road today?

jericho.question: What happened when Israel marched around Jericho, shouted and blew the trumpets?
jericho.about: Jericho was a strong walled city at the edge of the Promised Land. God told Joshua to march around it for seven days instead of attacking it.
jericho.think: Israel won by obeying a plan that made no sense. Trust God's way, even when it looks strange.

lost_sheep.question: In Jesus' story, how many sheep did the shepherd leave to look for the one that was lost?
lost_sheep.about: Religious leaders complained that Jesus welcomed sinners. He answered with stories of lost things that are searched for and found with great joy.
lost_sheep.think: Heaven rejoices over one who comes home. You are worth searching for.

gideon.question: Who asked God for a sign with a fleece of wool?
gideon.about: God called Gideon to rescue Israel from enemy raiders, but he felt weak and afraid. He asked God for signs, and God patiently gave them.
gideon.think: God patiently answered Gideon's doubts. Bring Him your honest questions.

prodigal.question: What did the father do when he saw his lost son coming home?
prodigal.about: A younger son took his share of the family wealth and wasted it far from home. When he was starving, he decided to go back to his father.
prodigal.think: The father ran. That is how God receives everyone who comes home.

samson.question: Whose great strength was linked to his uncut hair?
samson.about: Samson was set apart to God from birth, and his long hair was the sign of that vow. When Delilah had it cut, his strength left him.
samson.think: Samson's strength was God's gift, not his own. Stay close to the Giver, not only His gifts.

ten_lepers.question: How many of the ten healed lepers came back to thank Jesus?
ten_lepers.about: Ten men with leprosy called out to Jesus from a distance, and He sent them to the priests. On the way they were healed.
ten_lepers.think: Nine were healed; one came back to give thanks. Take a moment now to thank God.

ruth.question: Who told Naomi, "Where you go, I will go; your God will be my God"?
ruth.about: After Naomi lost her husband and sons in a foreign land, she decided to return home. Her daughter-in-law Ruth, a Moabite, refused to leave her.
ruth.think: Ruth chose faithful love when leaving was easier. Who needs your faithfulness this week?

zacchaeus.question: Who climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus?
zacchaeus.about: Zacchæus was a chief tax collector in Jericho, rich and disliked. He was short, so he climbed a tree to see Jesus passing by.
zacchaeus.think: Jesus went to Zacchæus' house before he had changed. He welcomes you just as you are.

samuel.question: Which boy heard God call his name at night in the temple?
samuel.about: Samuel was a boy serving in the house of God under Eli the priest. God called him by name at night and began speaking to him.
samuel.think: Samuel said, "Speak, for your servant is listening." Take a quiet minute today just to listen.

lazarus.question: Whom did Jesus raise from the dead after four days in the tomb?
lazarus.about: Lazarus, the brother of Mary and Martha, had died, and Jesus arrived four days later. He called him out of the tomb, alive.
lazarus.think: Jesus wept before He raised Lazarus. He cares about your sorrow, not only the solution.

goliath.question: Who killed the giant Goliath with a sling and a stone?
goliath.about: The Philistine giant Goliath defied Israel's army for forty days, and everyone was afraid. Young David faced him, trusting in God.
goliath.think: David came in the name of the LORD. Which giant in your life needs to meet that God?

bartimaeus.question: Which blind man shouted, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"?
bartimaeus.about: Bartimæus was a blind beggar sitting by the road outside Jericho. When he heard Jesus was passing, he cried out for mercy.
bartimaeus.think: When others told him to be quiet, he shouted louder. Don't stop calling out to Jesus.

shepherd_boy.question: What was David doing when Samuel came to anoint him king?
shepherd_boy.about: God sent the prophet Samuel to Jesse's family to anoint the next king. Jesse's youngest son, David, was out in the fields with the sheep.
shepherd_boy.think: God looks at the heart, not at outward appearance. He sees what others overlook in you.

children.question: When the disciples stopped people bringing children to Jesus, what did He do?
children.about: People were bringing their children for Jesus to bless, and the disciples thought He was too busy. Jesus was displeased with the disciples.
children.think: The kingdom belongs to those who come like children. Come to Him simply and trustingly.

solomon.question: Which king asked God for wisdom instead of riches?
solomon.about: When young Solomon became king, God told him to ask for whatever he wanted. Solomon asked for wisdom to rule God's people well.
solomon.think: Solomon asked for wisdom to serve others well. Ask God for wisdom in what you face today.

mary_martha.question: Which sister sat at Jesus' feet and listened while the other was busy serving?
mary_martha.about: Jesus was a guest at the home of the sisters Martha and Mary. Martha was busy serving while Mary sat listening to Him.
mary_martha.think: Jesus said Mary chose the better part. Make time today simply to be with Him.

ravens.question: Which prophet was fed by ravens beside a brook?
ravens.about: During a long drought in Israel, God sent the prophet Elijah to hide by a brook. Ravens brought him bread and meat each morning and evening.
ravens.think: God provided for Elijah one day at a time. Trust Him for today's bread.

great_catch.question: After a night of catching nothing, what happened when Peter let down the nets at Jesus' word?
options: So many fish that the nets began to break
great_catch.about: Peter and his partners had fished all night and caught nothing. When Jesus told them to try again, the catch was so great that Peter fell at His feet.
great_catch.think: Peter obeyed even when tired and doubtful. Try again where Jesus tells you to.

carmel_fire.question: When Elijah prayed on Mount Carmel, how did God answer?
options: A voice spoke from a cloud
carmel_fire.about: Israel was worshipping the false god Baal. Elijah challenged its prophets on Mount Carmel to see which God would answer by fire.
carmel_fire.think: Elijah prayed simply, and God answered. The LORD is God; bring Him your prayer today.

sower.question: In Jesus' parable of the sower, what does the seed stand for?
sower.about: Jesus told a story about a farmer whose seed fell on different kinds of ground. Each kind of ground shows how people respond to God's word.
sower.think: Good soil hears the word, holds it fast and bears fruit with patience. Keep today's word in your heart.

whisper.question: When God met Elijah on the mountain, how did He come?
whisper.about: Elijah was afraid, exhausted and alone after Queen Jezebel threatened his life. God met him on the mountain, not in power, but in a gentle whisper.
whisper.think: God was not in the noise but in the whisper. Find a quiet moment to hear Him today.

good_shepherd.question: Jesus said, "I am the good shepherd." What does the good shepherd do?
options: He lays down his life for the sheep
good_shepherd.about: Jesus compared Himself to a shepherd, and His people to sheep. A good shepherd protects his sheep even at the cost of his own life.
good_shepherd.think: The Shepherd who gave His life for you knows you by name.

naaman.question: Which army commander was healed of leprosy after washing seven times in the Jordan?
naaman.about: Naaman was a mighty commander of the Syrian army, but he had leprosy. The prophet Elisha told him to wash seven times in the Jordan River.
naaman.think: Naaman almost missed his healing because it seemed too simple. Don't despise the simple things God asks.

nicodemus.question: Who came to Jesus at night and heard that he must be born again?
nicodemus.about: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a leader of the Jews. He came to Jesus at night, and Jesus told him he needed a new birth from God.
nicodemus.think: Jesus spoke of new birth by the Spirit. It is never too late for a new beginning with God.

furnace.question: What happened to Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the fiery furnace?
options: The fire did not harm them
furnace.about: King Nebuchadnezzar ordered everyone to bow to his golden statue. Three young Jews refused, and they were thrown into a blazing furnace.
furnace.think: God did not keep them out of the fire, but He was with them in it. You are not alone in yours.

living_water.question: What did Jesus offer the Samaritan woman at the well?
living_water.about: Jesus spoke with a Samaritan woman at a well, though Jews and Samaritans did not usually mix. He offered her water that satisfies for ever.
living_water.think: Jesus offers water that becomes a spring of eternal life. Bring Him your thirst.

lions_den.question: Who was thrown into the lions' den for praying to God?
lions_den.about: Jealous officials tricked King Darius into a law that no one could pray to anyone but him for thirty days. Daniel kept praying to God.
lions_den.think: Daniel kept praying even when it was forbidden. What would faithfulness look like for you today?

cloak.question: A woman ill for twelve years was healed when she touched what?
cloak.about: A woman had been bleeding for twelve years and had spent everything on doctors. She believed that if she just touched Jesus' clothes, she would be healed.
cloak.think: Jesus told her, "Your faith has made you well; go in peace." Reach out to Him in faith today.

writing_wall.question: At whose feast did a hand appear and write on the wall?
writing_wall.about: King Belshazzar of Babylon held a great feast and drank from cups taken from God's temple. Suddenly a hand appeared and wrote on the wall.
writing_wall.think: The king was weighed and found wanting. Ask God to search your heart and set it right.

transfiguration.question: Who appeared with Jesus on the mountain when His face shone like the sun?
transfiguration.about: Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain. There His glory was shown, and two great men of the Old Testament spoke with Him.
transfiguration.think: The Father said, "Listen to Him." What has Jesus been saying to you lately?

jonah.question: Who was swallowed by a great fish after running from God?
jonah.about: God told Jonah to go to Nineveh, but he boarded a ship going the other way. A great storm came, and the sailors threw him into the sea.
jonah.think: Jonah ran from God, yet God came after him. It is never too late to turn back.

widow.question: How many small coins did the poor widow give, whom Jesus praised?
widow.about: Jesus watched people putting money into the temple treasury. The rich gave large amounts, but a poor widow gave everything she had.
widow.think: She gave all she had. God looks at the heart behind the gift, not its size.

nineveh.question: To which great city did God send Jonah to call the people to turn back?
nineveh.about: Nineveh was the great capital of Assyria, Israel's enemy. When Jonah finally preached there, the whole city turned to God.
nineveh.think: When Nineveh turned to God, He showed mercy. His mercy is wider than we expect.

greatest.question: Which commandment did Jesus call the greatest?
options: Love the Lord your God with all your heart
Give a tenth of all you earn
greatest.about: A teacher of the law asked Jesus which commandment was the most important. Jesus summed up all of God's law in two commands to love.
greatest.think: All God's law hangs on love for God and neighbour. Whom can you love in a practical way today?

esther.question: Which queen risked her life, saying, "If I perish, I perish"?
esther.about: Esther, a Jewish woman, had become queen of Persia when a plot was made to destroy her people. To save them she had to go to the king uninvited.
esther.think: "Who knows whether you have come for such a time as this?" Where has God placed you to make a difference?

last_supper.question: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus give His disciples to remember Him by?
last_supper.about: On the night before He died, Jesus shared the Passover meal with His disciples. He gave them bread and wine as signs of His body and blood.
last_supper.think: "Do this in remembrance of me." Remember today what Jesus gave for you.

wall_days.question: In Nehemiah's day, how long did it take to rebuild Jerusalem's wall?
wall_days.about: Nehemiah, a Jew serving the Persian king, came to rebuild Jerusalem's broken walls. Despite enemies and threats, the people finished the work.
wall_days.think: Even their enemies saw that the work was done with God's help. Keep building what He has given you to do.

feet.question: What did Jesus do for His disciples at the Last Supper to show them how to serve?
feet.about: At their last meal together, Jesus took a towel and washed His disciples' feet, the work of a servant. He told them to serve one another the same way.
feet.think: The Lord of all knelt with a towel. Where can you serve quietly today?

job.question: Who lost everything, yet said, "The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD"?
job.about: Job was a good man who suddenly lost his wealth and his children in one day. Yet in his grief he worshipped God.
job.think: Job worshipped in his grief. You can bring God your sorrow and still trust Him.

gethsemane.question: In the garden before His arrest, what did Jesus pray to His Father?
options: Not my will, but yours be done
gethsemane.about: After the Last Supper Jesus went to pray in the garden of Gethsemane. Knowing the suffering ahead, He prayed in deep anguish.
gethsemane.think: Jesus placed His will in the Father's hands. What do you need to place there today?

psalm23.question: Psalm 23 begins, "The LORD is my …"?
psalm23.about: David, who had been a shepherd himself, wrote this psalm. It describes God caring for us as a shepherd cares for his sheep.
psalm23.think: With the Shepherd you lack nothing, even in the darkest valley. Walk with Him today.

denial.question: Who denied knowing Jesus three times before the rooster crowed?
denial.about: Peter had promised he would never leave Jesus. That night, after Jesus' arrest, he was afraid and three times said he did not know Him.
denial.think: Jesus later restored Peter. Your failures are not the end of your story with Him.

eagles.question: Those who wait on the LORD will rise up with wings like what?
eagles.about: Isaiah wrote to God's people when they felt forgotten and weary. He reminded them that God never grows tired and gives strength to the weak.
eagles.think: He gives strength to the weary. Wait on Him, and let Him renew your strength today.

paradise.question: What did Jesus promise the thief on the cross who asked Him to remember him?
options: Today you will be with me in paradise
paradise.about: Two criminals were crucified with Jesus. One mocked Him, but the other turned to Him in faith.
paradise.think: It was not too late for the thief, and it is not too late for anyone. Who needs to hear this?

plans.question: God said, "I know the plans I have for you," plans to give you what?
plans.about: God's people had been taken into exile in Babylon. Jeremiah wrote a letter to tell them that God had not forgotten them.
plans.think: Even in exile, God had good plans for His people. Trust Him with your future.

risen.question: What did the angel tell the women at the empty tomb?
options: He is not here; He has risen
risen.about: On the first day of the week, women came to Jesus' tomb with spices. They found it empty, and an angel gave them the news.
risen.think: The tomb is empty and death is defeated. Live today in the hope of the risen Jesus.

potter.question: In Jeremiah, God compares Himself to whom, shaping clay?
potter.about: God sent Jeremiah to watch a potter at work. When a pot was spoiled, the potter reshaped it into something new.
potter.think: We are like clay in the potter's hands. Let Him reshape what is broken in you.

thomas.question: Which disciple said he would not believe until he touched Jesus' wounds?
thomas.about: Thomas was not with the other disciples when the risen Jesus appeared to them. A week later Jesus came again and showed Thomas His wounds.
thomas.think: Jesus met Thomas in his doubt. Bring Him your questions; He is not afraid of them.

image.question: In whose image did God create mankind?
image.about: In the beginning God created human beings, male and female. Of all creation, only they are made in His image.
image.think: You bear God's image. So does every person you meet today.

emmaus.question: On the road to Emmaus, when did the two disciples recognise Jesus?
emmaus.about: Two disciples were walking home sad after Jesus' death. A stranger joined them and explained the Scriptures, and they did not know it was Jesus.
emmaus.think: Jesus walked with them before they knew it was Him. He may be closer than you think.

babel.question: What did God do when people built the tower of Babel to reach the heavens?
babel.about: After the flood, people settled together and began building a city with a great tower to make a name for themselves.
babel.think: Pride builds towers to make a name; God humbles the proud. Seek His name above your own.

pentecost.question: At Pentecost, who filled the disciples, with tongues like fire?
pentecost.about: Fifty days after Jesus rose, His followers were praying together in Jerusalem. Suddenly the Holy Spirit came upon them, as Jesus had promised.
pentecost.think: The Spirit came to fill ordinary people with power. Ask Him to fill you today.

rock_water.question: What did God tell Moses to do so that water would come out of the rock?
rock_water.about: In the desert the people of Israel were thirsty and angry with Moses. God sent Moses to a rock at Horeb.
rock_water.think: God brought water from a rock in the desert. He can provide in your driest place.

damascus.question: Who met Jesus in a bright light on the road to Damascus?
damascus.about: Saul hated the followers of Jesus and was travelling to Damascus to arrest them. On the way the risen Jesus appeared to him; he later became the apostle Paul.
damascus.think: Jesus turned His fiercest enemy into His greatest messenger. No one is beyond His reach.

rainbow.question: What sign did God give of His promise never again to destroy the earth by a flood?
rainbow.about: After the flood Noah and his family came out of the ark. God made a covenant with them and with every living thing.
rainbow.think: Every rainbow is a reminder that God keeps His promises.

stephen.question: Who prayed for those who were stoning him, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them"?
stephen.about: Stephen was one of the first leaders chosen in the early church, full of faith and the Holy Spirit. He was stoned to death for preaching about Jesus.
stephen.think: Stephen forgave as Jesus did. Is there someone you need to forgive today?

fruit.question: Which comes first in the fruit of the Spirit?
fruit.about: Paul wrote to the churches in Galatia about life in the Spirit. The fruit of the Spirit is the character God grows in those who belong to Him.
fruit.think: Love comes first. Ask the Spirit to grow His fruit in you today.

lots_wife.question: What happened to Lot's wife when she looked back at Sodom?
options: She became a pillar of salt
lots_wife.about: God was about to destroy the wicked cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. Angels led Lot and his family out and told them not to look back.
lots_wife.think: She looked back at what God was leading her out of. Is there something you need to stop looking back at?

greatest_love.question: Of faith, hope and love, which does Paul call the greatest?
greatest_love.about: Paul wrote to the church in Corinth, which was proud of its spiritual gifts. He showed them that without love, all of it is nothing.
greatest_love.think: Love never fails. Where can you show that love today?

aaron.question: Who was the brother God gave Moses to speak for him?
aaron.about: When God sent Moses to Pharaoh, Moses said he was not a good speaker. God gave him his brother Aaron to speak for him.
aaron.think: God gave Moses a helper for his weakness. He gives us one another too.

sword.question: In the armour of God, what is the sword of the Spirit?
sword.about: Paul wrote from prison about the spiritual battle Christians face. He described the armour God gives, piece by piece, like a Roman soldier's.
sword.think: God's word is your weapon against fear and lies. Which verse will you carry with you today?

joshua.question: To whom did God say, "Be strong and courageous… the LORD your God is with you wherever you go"?
joshua.about: After Moses died, Joshua had to lead Israel into the Promised Land. God spoke to him to give him courage for the task.
joshua.think: Courage comes from God's presence, not your own strength. Go into today knowing He is with you.

thanksgiving.question: Paul wrote, "Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer … present your requests to God," with what?
thanksgiving.about: Paul wrote this from prison to the church in Philippi. Even in chains, he taught them how to find God's peace in place of worry.
thanksgiving.think: Thanksgiving and prayer open the way for God's peace. Thank Him now for three things.

tears.question: In Revelation, what will God wipe away from every eye?
tears.about: In the last book of the Bible, John was given a vision of the new heaven and new earth. God Himself will live with His people for ever.
tears.think: One day there will be no more death or pain. Let that hope carry you through today.
